messages.businessImpact: Old versions continue to install alongside their replacements, which is how an estate ends up running two versions of the same product.
remediation: Remove the assignments from the superseded packages, keeping the packages themselves for supersedence to work.
messages.cannotSee: Supersedence is read one application at a time, so an application whose relationships this run could not read is not judged. Whether the superseding package has actually replaced the old one on a device is per-device state this release does not collect.
